scope: Larger map canvas through a compact header, grouped spatial/display toolbar, footer attribution, and responsive panel placement.
ownerRequest: เพิ่มขนาดแผนที่ให้ใหญ่ขึ้น และจัดพื้นที่ว่างให้ดีขึ้น

layout.header: Title and subtitle share a row where space permits; module context remains screen-reader readable.
layout.toolbar: Breadcrumbs and area-level buttons grouped together; basemap and area-colour controls wrap as one display group.
layout.map: Persistent existing MapLibre instance; actual canvas grows into recovered space. No new fit/zoom action on resize.
layout.footer: Provider attribution and basemap status stay visible. Dataset/version details remain available in native disclosure.
layout.below1100: Full-width map followed by details panel in document flow; narrow cooperative gestures use the same breakpoint.
layout.phone: Legend remains below the map; controls retain 44px targets.

verification.visual: CUA: 390 and 768 dark, 1366x768 dark, 900 light/dark with four-level building breadcrumb and real satellite attribution, 1440 light and 1728 light/dark. The map-only stacked layout retains the existing navigation at 900px. No header-control overlap observed.
verification.mechanicalLayoutScan: Impeccable layout detector: no findings before or after implementation.
verification.scopeLimit: Browser preview and layout review; not a native-device or full accessibility audit.

automatedResult.scope: Local Chromium: all previous123 checks plus5 aggregated geometry gates across three map views, desktop/phone/tablet, short laptop, long building breadcrumb and full synthetic-provider satellite credit. Native-device/full accessibility coverage is not claimed.
